summary: Morgan Stanley Direct Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement to issue $350 million aggregate principal amount of its 6.100% Notes due 2031. The offering is a registered shelf takedown under an effective N-2 shelf registration statement. The underwriting agreement involves several underwriters and contains customary representations, warranties, and indemnification provisions. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring is present. The filing is a standard debt issuance documented under Item 1.01.
